decisions.reason: As a new product very close to the firm's core dosimetry and calibration business and prominent on the home page, it likely meets or is close enough to aspirations that an expanding firm with technological slack would continue supporting it.

Although software adoption in oncology can be more uncertain than an instrument launch, it builds on the firm's established QA offering and the firm's growth, broad portfolio, and R&D capabilities make retention more likely than withdrawal.
